subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): propagate deadline signal and skip exhaustive fallback for supplement search

question: Should MemoryCorpusSupplement.search officially accept AbortSignal and permit deadline-bounded partial results instead of exhaustively filling maxResults?
rationale: The patch changes a documented plugin API and deliberately trades current supplement result completeness for bounded latency, which cannot be established solely from implementation correctness.

options.title: Approve bounded partial supplements
options.body: Document the optional signal and best-effort partial-result semantics, make actual reads abort-aware, preserve exhaustive direct wiki_search, and require live proof.

options.title: Preserve exhaustive supplements
options.body: Keep existing result completeness and limit the repair to cooperative cancellation of the exhaustive scan path.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded partial supplements
recommendation.body: Document the optional signal and best-effort partial-result semantics, make actual reads abort-aware, preserve exhaustive direct wiki_search, and require live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced both the corpus supplement bridge and the digest retrieval/fallback behavior whose permanent contract is being changed.
